claim: Distillerie de Namur-Bossimé is a micro-distillery at Rue Bossimé 2B, 5101 Loyers (Namur), making fruit eaux-de-vie, liqueurs and 'The Blackbird's Gin' with Wépion strawberry, with no artificial flavour or colour.
quote: Rue Bossimé, 2B, 5101, Loyers ... The Blackbird's gin à la fraise de wépion ... sans colorants, sans arômes artificiels, sans exhausteurs de goûts

claim: Wave Distil is a craft distillery at Grand'route de Ciney 104, 5503 Dinant, producing the Ginneke'Tiche London dry gin and Manneke'Tiche pure malt whisky.
Wave Distil welcomes visitors by appointment in groups, runs masterclass tastings and opened a Gourmet Bistro inside the distillery in October 2023.
quote: It is possible to visit the distillery, but only by group, by appointment, and it offers events such as Masterclass tastings, private or professional evenings, teambuilding and gourmet bistro meals.

claim: Wave Distil in Sorinnes/Dinant launched its Ginneke'Tiche gin in 2022, distilled from local Belgian barley.
quote: Dinant : du gin distillé à partir d'un orge local

claim: VisitWallonia lists craft distilleries open for tours including Belgian Owl (Fexhe, single malt whisky) and Distillerie de Biercée (Ragnies, eaux-de-vie and liqueurs) — both more than 30 km from Profondeville.
quote: The Owl Distillery ... Single Malt Whisky 100 % belge distillé dans des alambics écossais ... Distillerie de Biercée - Ragnies ... eaux-de-vie et liqueurs

claim: Dinant Evasion enforces strict Lesse-kayak rules: no cool boxes/barbecues/beer crates, no stopping outside marked zones, no fires, no littering, with kayaks ID-tagged to renters — yet more than 10 rubbish bags are still collected weekly from the banks.
quote: strictly forbidden: To take cool boxes, portable barbecues or beer crates on board ... more than 10 rubbish bags are collected every week on the banks of the Lesse

claim: The Lesse kayak descent has been suspended in recent dry summers; since July 2023 the 21 km and 9 km Houyet runs were halted by drought to protect flora and fauna.
quote: La descente de la Lesse en canoë-kayak suspendue en raison de la sécheresse

claim: Minimum flow thresholds for navigation are only 2 m³/s Houyet–Gendron and 1.5 m³/s Gendron–Anseremme — so low that kayaks scrape the bottom, prompting Wallonia to commission a study to raise the thresholds.
quote: Kayaks qui touchent le fond: faut-il rehausser les débits seuils de la Lesse par temps de sécheresse?

claim: During the 2023 drought only the 12 km Gendron–Anseremme run remained open; the longer Houyet routes were closed.
quote: Sécheresse de la Lesse: un seul parcours kayak reste praticable, le 12 km au départ de Gendron

claim: Visitor reviews of Dinant Evasion's Lesse descents describe overcrowding ('you could barely see the river … so many kayaks') and chaotic docking at portages.
quote: you could barely see the river at certain times because so many kayaks sailed on it ... chaos when docking
